questions.question: What is the value of {1+xover1-{x²}}div{1+xover1-{x⁴}}-{1-x⁴over1-{x}}times{(1+x)over1-{x²}}
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(1+x)/(1-x²)div (1+x)/(1-x⁴)-(1-x⁴)/(1-x)times (1+x)/(1-x²)

**Calculation:**

(1+x)/(1-x²)div (1+x)/(1-x⁴)-(1-x⁴)/(1-x)times (1+x)/(1-x²)

**(1+x)/(1-x²)times (1-x⁴)/(1+x)-(1-x⁴)/(1-x)times (1+x)/(1-x²)**

1+x²-(1-x⁴)/(1-x)times (1+x)/(1-x²)

1+x²-{1+x²}times (1+x)/(1-x)

(1-x+x²-x³-1-x-x²-x³)/(1-x)

{2x(1+x²)}over{(x-1)}

 

**Therefore, the value of the given expression is {2x(1+x²)}over{(x-1)}.**

questions.question: If sin (θ + 30) = cos 5θ, then what is the value of θ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 sin (θ + 30) = cos 5θ

**Concept:**

The sine of the complement of an angle is equal to the cosine of the angle.

**Calculation:**

⇒ sin (90 - 5θ) = cos 5θ

⇒ θ + 30 = 90 - 5θ

⇒ 6θ = 60

⇒ θ = 60/6

**Therefore, θ = 10°**

questions.question: Shivam purchased two watches, first for Rs. 12000 and the second for Rs. 20,000. He sold both the watches, first one at the profit of 10 percent and the second at a loss of 20 percent. What is the overall profit or loss?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate individual **profit** and **loss** values based on the respective **Cost Prices**.

**Profit** on the 1st watch = 10% of 12000 = ₹1200.

**Loss** on the 2nd watch = 20% of 20000 = ₹4000.

**Net Result** = 1200 − 4000 = −2800 (Negative sign indicates loss).

**∴ The correct answer is Loss = Rs. 2800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Cost Price** of 1st watch (CP₁) = ₹12000

**Cost Price** of 2ⁿd watch (CP₂) = ₹20000

**Profit %** on 1st watch = 10%

**Loss %** on 2ⁿd watch = 20%

**Formula:** Profit or Loss = (Rate / 100) × Cost Price

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26b5d68922e099582da8ede3c81e1888e9c094e502fcfd5aff1831969bbdbc94.png] 

⇒ **Profit** on 1st watch = (10 / 100) × 12000 = ₹1200

⇒ **Loss** on 2ⁿd watch = (20 / 100) × 20000 = ₹4000

⇒ **Overall Gain/Loss** = Total Profit − Total Loss

⇒ **Overall Gain/Loss** = 1200 − 4000 = −₹2800

⇒ Negative value implies a **Loss** of ₹2800.

**∴ The correct answer is Loss = Rs. 2800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Overall Profit or Loss Percentage

It is calculated as (Net Profit or Loss ÷ Total Cost Price) × 100. In this case: (2800 ÷ 32000) × 100 = 8.75% loss.

Selling Price Calculation

SP = CP × (100 ± Profit/Loss%) ÷ 100. Here, Total SP = ₹13200 + ₹16000 = ₹29200.

Successive Percentage Shortcut

When two items are sold, direct subtraction of values is only possible if the **Cost Price** is used as the base for both calculations.

questions.question: Excluding stoppages, the speed of a bus is 60 kmph and including stoppages, it is 54 kmph. For how many minutes does the bus stop per hour?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Stoppage time per hour = (Faster Speed − Slower Speed) ÷ Faster Speed

Stoppage time = (60 − 54) ÷ 60

Stoppage time = 6 ÷ 60 hour

Stoppage time in minutes = (1/10) × 60 = 6 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 6 mins.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed without stoppages = 60 kmph

Speed with stoppages = 54 kmph

 
• 
 
• 

 Without Stoppage (Speed: 60 kmph)
 
 Distance: 60 km in 60 mins
 
 With Stoppage (Speed: 54 kmph)
 
 Distance: 54 km

 
 Stop

 

 6 km gap
 Takes 6 mins

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ In 1 hour (60 mins), without stoppages, the bus covers a distance of 60 km.

⇒ In 1 hour (60 mins), with stoppages, the bus covers a distance of 54 km.

⇒ Loss in distance due to stoppages = 60 − 54 = 6 km.

⇒ Time required to cover this 6 km gap at the original speed is the actual stoppage time.

⇒ Stoppage time = Distance ÷ Original Speed

⇒ Stoppage time = 6 ÷ 60 hours = 1/10 hours.

⇒ Stoppage time in minutes = (1/10) × 60 = 6 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 mins.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

When equal distances are covered at speeds S₁ and S₂, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂). For equal time intervals, Average Speed = (S₁ + S₂) ÷ 2.

Relative Speed

For two bodies moving in the same direction, relative speed is |S₁ − S₂|. For bodies moving in opposite directions, it is S₁ + S₂.

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert kmph to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert m/s to kmph, multiply the value by 18/5.

questions.question: The salary of an employee increases consistently by 20% every year. If his salary today is Rs. 14,000, what will be his salary after 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Current salary: Rs. 14000

Annual salary increase: 20%

Number of years: 3

**Solution:**

Calculate the salary after 3 years using compound interest formula:

Final salary = Current salary × (1 + rate)^time

Final salary = 14000 × (1 + 0.2)³ = 14000 × 1.728

**Therefore, the salary after 3 years will be Rs. 24,192.**

questions.question: If sum of squares of two real numbers is 12 and the product of the numbers is 4, find the difference between the numbers.
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Sum of squares of two numbers = 12,

Product of the numbers = 4

**Solution:**

Let the numbers be 'a' and 'b'.

a² + b² = 12

ab = 4

(a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b²

(a - b)² = 12 - 2(4)

(a - b)² = 4

Taking the square root of both sides, we get:

a - b = ±2

**Therefore, the difference between the numbers is ±2.**

questions.solution:

Radius of the circle: 7 units

**Therefore, the length of the arc is 22/3 units.**

questions.question: Find the area of a circle whose radius is equal to the side of a square whose perimeter is 196 m.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of the square = 196 m

**Solution:**

Formula: Perimeter of a square = 4 × side

Substitute the given perimeter: 196 = 4 × side

Solve for the side: side = 196/4 = 49 m

Formula: Area of a circle = π × radius²

Substitute the side as the radius: Area = π × (49)² = 2401π m²

⇒ 2401 × 22/7 = 7546 m²

 

**Therefore, the area of the circle is 7546 m2.**

questions.question: If 3 tan θ = 4, then what is the value of 7 sin θ - 2 cos θ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 

3 tan θ = 4

**Concept Used:**

tan θ = Perpendicular/Base = P/B

sin θ = Perpendicular/Hypotenuse = P/H

cos θ = Base/Hypotenuse = B/H

**Calculation:**

tan θ = 4/3 = P/B

⇒ P = 4 and B = 3

Apply Pythagorean rule for H

⇒ H² = P² + B²

⇒ H2 = 42 + 3² = 16 + 9

⇒ H = 5

⇒ sin θ = P/H = 4/5

⇒ cos θ = B/H = 3/5

⇒ 7 sin θ - 2 cos θ = 7 × 4/5 - 2 × 3/5

⇒ 28/5 - 6/5 = 22/5

**∴ 7 sin θ - 2 cos θ = 22/5**

questions.question: In a cyclic quadrilateral EFGH, ∠E is opposite to ∠G. If ∠E = 95 degree, then what is the value of ∠G?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠E = 95°,

EFGH is a cyclic quadrilateral.

**Concept Used:**

In a cyclic quadrilateral, the opposite angles are supplementary.

**Solution:**

∠E + ∠G = 180°

95° + ∠G = 180°

∠G = 180° - 95° = 85° 

**Therefore, the value of ∠G is 85°.**

questions.question: If A : B = 2 : 3, B : C = 6 : 7, C : D = 14 : 3, then find A : B : C : D
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To find the **combined ratio**, equalize the common terms **B** and **C**.

Multiply A : B (2 : 3) by 2 to match B in B : C (6 : 7) ⇒ **4 : 6**.

Now we have A : B : C = 4 : 6 : 7.

Multiply A : B : C (4 : 6 : 7) by 2 to match C in C : D (14 : 3) ⇒ **8 : 12 : 14**.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 12 : 14 : 3.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A : B = 2 : 3

B : C = 6 : 7

C : D = 14 : 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2df09d9d838dec7343ac26671c27b22f2f9f9b85dcbae235044d3a130d7da325.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ We have A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 6 : 7.

⇒ To make **B** common, multiply the first ratio by 2: A : B = (2 × 2) : (3 × 2) = 4 : 6.

⇒ Now, A : B : C = 4 : 6 : 7.

⇒ We have A : B : C = 4 : 6 : 7 and C : D = 14 : 3.

⇒ To make **C** common, multiply the combined ratio (A:B:C) by 2: (4 × 2) : (6 × 2) : (7 × 2) = 8 : 12 : 14.

⇒ Now, the combined ratio becomes A : B : C : D = 8 : 12 : 14 : 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 12 : 14 : 3.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of two ratios a : b and c : d is found by multiplying the corresponding terms: ac : bd.

Duplicate and Sub-duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a : b is a² : b², and the sub-duplicate ratio is √a : √b.

Continued Proportion

Three quantities a, b, and c are said to be in continued proportion if a : b = b : c, where b is the mean proportional (b² = ac).

Invertendo and Alternendo

If a : b = c : d, then b : a = d : c (Invertendo) and a : c = b : d (Alternendo).</p

questions.question: The difference between the compound interest (compounding half yearly) for 1 year and the simple interest for 1 year on a certain sum lent out at the annual rate of 10 percent is Rs. 25. What is the sum?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Difference between compound interest and simple interest = Rs. 25,

Annual interest rate = 10%

**Concept Used:**

Compound Interest for 1 year = P[(1 + r/100)ⁿ - 1], where r is the annual interest rate and n is the number of compounding periods.

Simple Interest for 1 year = (P × r × t) / 100, where r is the annual interest rate and t is the time period in years.

**Solution:**

Let the principal sum be 'P'.

The given difference is:

P[(1 + 5/100)² - 1] - (P × 10 × 1) / 100 = 25

Solving the equation, we find P = Rs. 10,000.

**Therefore, the sum lent out is Rs. 10,000.**

questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 20 days. B and C together can complete the same work in 15 days. If A, B and C all work together, then the same work gets completed in 10 days. How many days will A and C together take to complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can complete a work in 20 days.

B and C together can complete the same work in 15 days.

A, B and C all work together, then the same work gets completed in 10 days.

**Concept Used:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM(20, 15, 10) = 60 units

Efficiency of A and B together = 60/20 = 3 .......(i)

Efficiency of B and C together = 60/15 = 4 ........(ii)

Efficiency of A, B and C together = 60/10 = 6. .......(iii)

Solve (i) and (iii)

Efficiency of C = 6 - 3 = 3

Put in (ii)

Efficiency of B = 4 - 3 = 1

Put in (i)

Efficiency of A = 3 - 1 = 2

Efficiency of A + C = 3 + 2 = 5

A and B together can complete a work = 60/5 = 12 days

**A and C together take to 12 days complete the same work.**

questions.question: A man spends Rs. 2,300 monthly on average for the first four months and Rs. 1,800 monthly for the next eight months and saves Rs. 12,400 a year. Find his monthly income.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Monthly Income** = (Total Yearly Expenditure + Yearly Savings) ÷ 12

Total Yearly Expenditure = (4 × 2300) + (8 × 1800) = 9200 + 14400 = Rs. 23,600

Total Yearly Income = 23,600 + 12,400 = Rs. 36,000

Monthly Income = 36,000 ÷ 12 = Rs. 3,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 3,000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average expenditure for first 4 months = Rs. 2,300

Average expenditure for next 8 months = Rs. 1,800

Total **annual savings** = Rs. 12,400

**Formula Used:**

Total Income = Total Expenditure + Total Savings

Monthly Income = Total Annual Income ÷ 12

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c95ef8a1b33325e311f42f276e176148107c20cd5bf26f96ec17de8f24512f5.png] 

⇒ Total Expenditure for first 4 months = 4 × 2300 = Rs. 9,200

⇒ Total Expenditure for next 8 months = 8 × 1800 = Rs. 14,400

⇒ Total Annual Expenditure = 9,200 + 14,400 = Rs. 23,600

⇒ Total Annual Income = Annual Expenditure + Annual Savings

⇒ Total Annual Income = 23,600 + 12,400 = Rs. 36,000

⇒ **Monthly Income** = 36,000 ÷ 12 = Rs. 3,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 3,000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Income and Expenditure Relationship

The fundamental relation is **Income = Expenditure + Savings**. Any change in one parameter directly affects the others when the third is constant.

Weighted Average

When calculating average for different periods, use the weighted average formula: **Avg = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)**, where n represents the number of months.

Unit Consistency

Always ensure the time periods match. If savings are given **annually**, convert expenditures to an annual sum before calculating monthly income.</p

questions.question: If 6 sec θ = 10, then find the value of (5 cosec θ - 3 cot θ)/(4 cos θ + 3 sin θ).
questions.solution:
**Given: **

6 sec θ = 10

**Concept:**

Sec θ = 1/cos θ,

cosec θ = 1/sin θ,

cot θ = cos θ/sin θ

**Calculation:**

6 sec θ = 10

⇒ sec θ = 10/6

⇒ cos θ = 6/10 = 3/5

⇒ sin θ = √(1 - cos² θ) = √(1 - 9/25)

⇒ sin θ = √(16/25)

⇒ sin θ = 4/5

⇒ cosec θ = 1/sin θ = 5/4

⇒ cot θ = cos θ/sin θ = 3/5/4/5 = 3/4

Put the values in (5 cosec θ - 3 cot θ)/(4 cos θ + 3 sin θ)

⇒ (5 × 5/4 - 3 × 3/4)/(4 × 3/5 + 3 × 4/5)

⇒ (25/4 - 9/4)/(12/5 + 12/5)

⇒ (16/4)/(24/5)

⇒ 5/6

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
